summary: Regression pass for LOKAGER Module 1 (frozen) + /launch. All acceptance criteria verified end-to-end on the preview URL. Zero console errors, zero page errors, zero broken images, zero horizontal overflow at 1920/1440/1366/430/390 across home, all 6 verticals, /property/:slug, /saved, /saved?ids=, and /compare. No regressions vs iteration_10.
verified_flows: Home / loads: hero-headline present ('Find property you can trust.'), header logo lockup + full desktop nav visible, sticky header intact, no console errors, 0px overflow at 1920/1440/1366/430/390.
Ad showcase: ad-video-showcase-section, ad-play-toggle, ad-mute-toggle, ad-disclosure all present on home.

Vertical pages /buy /rent /new-projects /commercial /land /mortgage all load with breadcrumbs, filter-bar, correct h1, and cards: /buy=6, /rent=5, /new-projects=3 projects (12 sub-testids), /commercial=5, /land=4, /mortgage=0 (calculator page with emi-calculator+emi-result). 0px overflow on all.
Property detail (/property/4-bhk-garden-villa-pb-201): detail-title, detail-price (₹4.2 Cr), detail-share, detail-interest, property-gallery all render; 0 overflow.
Save: clicking property-card-<id>-save toggles saved state and header saved-count live-updates from 0 → 1 → 2 in same tab; /saved lists items and persists via localStorage.
Compare cap: 4 add attempts leave exactly 3 thumbs in compare-tray (4th blocked). compare-open enabled at ≥2.
/compare: compare-table renders with 9 rows for 3 selections; compare-page-clear empties store.
Share: share-shortlist-button on /saved copies https://.../saved?ids=PB-201,PB-202 to clipboard.
Shared invalid IDs: /saved?ids=BADID999 shows graceful 'shared shortlist is empty' state; no crash.
Launch ceremony: /launch shows launch-button (no auto-start); clicking transitions to countdown-screen. Refreshing /launch returns to opening state (launch-button back, countdown gone).
Mobile 390px: desktop-nav hidden (hamburger/mobile layout active); home overflow 0.
critical_code_review_comments: No new issues found. Prior notes from iteration_10 still apply (useCompare module-scoped state; SavedPage clipboard fallback UX).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Frozen Module 1 is stable and deploy-ready. When adding new compare items, remember property-card-<id>-save/-view/-compare are separate testids; filter cards by stripping those suffixes when picking outer cards. Clipboard requires context.grant_permissions(['clipboard-read','clipboard-write'], origin='https://lokager-launch.preview.emergentagent.com').
